title: Proxmox · Galaxy Cluster
description: The cluster as Proxmox itself sees it: quorum, the five nodes, every guest, and the storages behind them.

panels.title: Guests stopped
panels.description: Templates and spare guests are stopped on purpose.

panels.title: Guests with no backup
panels.description: No vzdump archive on any storage Proxmox can see. This lab keeps no backups, so it counts every guest.

targets.expr: pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: A shared storage appears once per node that mounts it.
